name: Passkey New User Registration
summary: Registers a new passkey identity through PendingIdentity, creates one durable user, and binds the credential without premature application authorization.

entryPredicate.expression: pending-identity-status == pending and pending-identity-flow == passkey and durable-identity == absent

completionPredicate.expression: pending-identity-status == resolved and credential-proof == passkey-proved and durable-identity == resolved and home-workspace == required
